Bhumi Amla Powder Exporter — Discover Premium Bhumi Amla Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Tradenest Naturals operates as a leading bhumi amla powder exporter and bulk manufacturer based in India. We harness advanced processing techniques to transform carefully harvested Phyllanthus niruri plants into a pure, nutrient-rich herbal powder. Therefore, businesses worldwide trust us for high-grade botanical ingredients that elevate health and wellness formulations.

Why Choose Our Manufacturing Facility?

Our production unit utilizes strict quality control measures to maintain the natural integrity of the herb. First, we source raw materials directly from trusted agricultural networks. Next, we clean, dry, and pulverize the whole plant under hygienic conditions. As a result, our output meets stringent international food safety and herbal standards.

Key Specifications of Our Wholesale Herb Powder

  • Botanical Name: Phyllanthus niruri
  • Particle Size: 80 to 100 mesh for optimal solubility
  • Moisture Content: Below 7 percent to prevent caking
  • Purity: 100 percent natural with zero additives

Applications Across Multiple Industries

Our bulk bhumi amla powder supplier services support diverse commercial sectors. For example, nutraceutical companies use this ingredient to formulate liver support capsules and herbal immunity blends. In addition, cosmetic brands incorporate the extract into hair care tonics because of its traditional cleansing properties. Meanwhile, functional beverage brands add the fine powder to herbal teas and health mixes.

Packaging Options and Shelf-Life Stability

We pack our bhumi amla powder wholesale shipments in food-grade, moisture-barrier materials. You can order in standard 25 kg export drums, HDPE containers, or custom private-label pouches. Because we seal each batch carefully, the product retains its potency for up to twenty-four months when stored in a cool, dry place.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for a bhumi amla powder exporter? Our standard MOQ is flexible, starting at 100 kg for bulk orders, though custom private-label runs may require higher quantities. What are the typical lead times for export orders? Production and dispatch typically take between 10 to 15 business days depending on destination requirements. How do I request a sample or price quote? You can contact our sales team directly through our website to receive a competitive bhumi amla powder price per kg quote and request product samples.
